sloka: नवीकृतं च तत्सर्वं वाक्यैस्ते धर्मचारिणि ।पतिशुश्रूषणान्नार्य्यास्तपो नान्यद्विधीयते ॥ २.११८.९॥
transliteration: navīkṛtaṁ ca tatsarvaṁ vākyaiste dharmacāriṇi ।patiśuśrūṣaṇānnāryyāstapo nānyadvidhīyate ॥ 2.118.9॥

translations.english: O righteous one (Anasuya), after listening to your words the instructions given by my motherinlaw and my mother are renewed (remembered again). For a woman, no other penance is laid down (in scriptures) except service to her husband.
